pr.title: feat(fs-forge-cli): dynamic feature flags in help output
pr.body: Adds dynamic feature-flag rendering to the custom oclif help.
pr.author: vieitesss

nodes.body: Quick question — `withDynamicFeatureFlags` assigns `commandClass.flags` and `FLAG_SPECS` directly on the command class that oclif caches. If something else in the same process loads this command afterwards (another help call, or the actual command run), won't it see the dynamically-injected flags from this one-off help render? Should this clone the class instead of mutating it?
Nice cleanup of the JSON help output — this is much easier to read than before. LGTM.
Please extract this `serializable` helper into a shared util — other commands will need it too.
Actually, scratch that — I checked and nothing else serializes oclif flags today. Fine where it is.
